title: The keep in weather
line: Cliff, rain, gothic server-fortress. Lightning. Title card over a window full of rain.

title: The false resurrection
line: Generator catch. Fabrication bay lamp. Table. Second strike. Optic ignites. Body lock lives here.

title: Born beside absence
line: He sits up. Dust-outline of the unmade twin. He reaches. Does not fill it.

title: The date that names him obsolete
line: Cracked phone on the bench: August 2026, WAKE PAIR — BAY 3. He understands enough.

title: Rain on server glass
line: Palm to the window. Tower in volumetric rain. Continuity pickup cleared a mid-plate laterality flip.

title: The lever nobody pulls
line: Control dais. He studies the caged red lever. Leaves it. First moral choice: he will not pretend to be the departed.

title: Faces that are not his
line: Curling ID badges. No match. He is unfiled. Head holds; chest plate still not the locked copper.

title: The well of light
line: Spiral service stair. God rays, rust motes. He climbs. Beat holds; torso still cylindrical vs KF02.

title: The sag
line: Mid-climb power flicker. He sits with the leak of rain. Stands because he can.

title: Threshold
line: Door of light. Wind, salt. He steps through. Face never turns to camera on this lock.

title: The world that does not look back
line: Roof. Breaking storm. Gold seam on the water. Distant van — years-still, unreadable. Profile in gold.

title: The door (full short)
line: Teaser held the roof as last image, then black. The full short does not cut. He looks down the cliff path.

title: Down, not over
line: He looks down the wet switchbacks. Van resolves as a coat on a headrest. Nobody gets out. Over the parapet.

title: The path that was never printed
line: Goat trail. Sea louder. The keep rises behind him as a place he left. Still is locked; the walk is parked.

still.alt: kf14d path — locked still, walk parked

title: Rain school
line: Rain hits the crooked plate in the open. Water runs a seam into grass. The world wets him without meaning to fix or ruin him.

title: Moss that is not rust
line: Living green on a rock. Finger. Recoil. Same finger back. Hold. Continuity pickup cleared a profile laterality kill.

title: The tide pool that looks back
line: A dish of sky in the rocks. Anemone. Hermit in a stolen shell. He does not try to keep the pool.

title: Wind in grass
line: Grass lays down, stands, lays down. A faint copper note from his plate. Still freeze stands; motion not locked.

title: The theft
line: A storm-petrel pecks the mismatched plate and steals a copper flake. Gone. First wound that is not the twin.

title: The return
line: Nest ledge: plastic, bone, wire. The petrel drops the flake at his feet. Not food. Not apology. A leftover, given back.

title: The three-legged fox
line: Downhill, failing a crab. Old amputation. Leftover recognizes leftover across ten yards of wet rock.

title: Shared weather, not a rescue
line: Squall. Same lee of a basalt tooth. She sleeps with one eye. He sits. Petrel above. That is the fellowship.

title: The empty socket / the empty air
line: He touches his dark socket. She licks the old seam where a fourth leg is not. Neither fills the other’s absence.

title: He does not go back
line: Squall tears. Keep small on the headland. He looks at it the way he looked at the unpulled lever. Leaves it.

title: Horizon hold
line: He walks. Fox at a chosen distance. Petrel as a dark hyphen over the water. Keep behind, gold ahead. End card: rustboy.ai.
